long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Galveston, Tilman J. Fertitta entered the restaurant business as a young entrepreneur. He became a partner in the first Landry's Seafood restaurant in 1980, gained control of Landry's in 1986 and built it through expansion and acquisitions across restaurants, hotels, casinos and entertainment destinations. He later took the company public, then returned it to private ownership in 2010.

Fertitta remains the sole owner and CEO of Fertitta Entertainment, whose holdings include Landry's, Golden Nugget and the Houston Rockets. His public career shifted in 2025 when he became United States ambassador to Italy and San Marino. His successive yachts have carried the Boardwalk name, an homage to Landry's Kemah Boardwalk property; in 2026 he took delivery of a 117-metre Lürssen bearing that name.
